title: The dilation η_{x,λ} maps B_ρ(x) onto B_{ρ/λ}(0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, ρ ∈ ℝ and λ > 0, and let η = η_{x,λ}, η(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x) (Contract `dilation x λ`, y ↦ −λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹y; ℝ^P = Euclid P). Then η⁻¹(B_{ρ/λ}(0)) = B_ρ(x) and η(B_ρ(x)) = B_{ρ/λ}(0), where B_r(a) = {y : ‖y − a‖ < r} is the open Euclidean ball (empty when r ≤ 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (ρ lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → dilation x lam ⁻¹' ball 0 (ρ / lam) = ball x ρ ∧ dilation x lam '' ball x ρ = ball 0 (ρ / lam)
